authority_checks: assignment is active, not recused, and within its effective dates
role and circle are active and within the role effective dates
authority domain is active and exactly matches requested domain and scope
maximum applicable authority level meets the requested minimum
any human-approval requirement at the maximum authority level is surfaced

decision_contract.authorized: Role authority meets the requested level and no separate human gate is configured.
decision_contract.approval_required: Role authority meets the requested level, but the caller must complete a separate human approval flow before execution.
decision_contract.denied: No active authority path meets the requested level.

compatibility: role_can_act remains a boolean authority-threshold helper and does not itself authorize an action when a human approval gate is configured.

checks.runtime_sql_inventory: current; regenerated to include six Gateway reader modules and 28 previously unreported SQL sites, for 841 service files and 4055 execution sites

limitations: This evaluates role authority; it does not create or approve a governed action.
OIDC operator identities do not yet map to governance party records, so Gateway mutation/audit attribution remains unsafe and deferred.
No action-level human approval record or domain-table RLS is added.
